## D11-F1 value grade (2026-09-25, review MED-1, no re-render)

R1 measured the 15 shipped `env_station_*.png` brighter than the ships they sit behind (hero mean 0.237, docking arms up to 0.277 vs the vanguard hull 0.175), inverting `ENVIRONMENT_SPEC` §1.1/§1.3's "environment reads one value step darker than ships". Fix: a local RGB value grade by `staging/phase_g/grade_d11_values.py` (`uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with pillow`, `--apply`) rescales every non-ember pixel so each file's mean max-channel over opaque pixels lands at 0.160 (below the old station's 0.1645 and the vanguard's 0.1786, same method). Alpha bytes, canvas size, ember-hot pixels (`r>170 & r-b>80`) and therefore every layout pin, QC hot/accent/transparency number and §6's one-emissive row stay as approved; nine stored `qc_results.json` `accent_share` values were refreshed downward by `--update-rows` (darkening can only drop them; all remain ≤ 0.00065 vs the 0.001 line). Reversal: copy `staging/phase_g/_d11_pregrade/*.png` (md5 manifest in `manifest.json`) back over `vajb-orbit/assets/env/poi/`, then run `--update-rows` again.
